q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
Q2 FY2027 earnings will be released in approximately Q3 2026 (typically late August/early September for NVIDIA's fiscal calendar). Today is 2026-08-22, so resolution is roughly 1-3 weeks away. This is an extremely short timeframe — the guidance has already been issued.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue. According to the research provided, **this guidance has already been issued on May 20, 2026**: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (floor ~$89.2B, ceiling ~$92.8B).

This is not a prediction question — it's asking about a known fact that has already occurred. The guidance range is explicitly stated in investor communications and SEC filings referenced in the research.

The most likely outcome is that the reported guidance **will be $91.0 billion**, with the ±2% band representing the standard risk disclosure range NVIDIA provides.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- If the question is interpreted as asking for the *actual reported revenue* for Q2 FY2027 (not guidance), it could fall below guidance due to:
  - Unexpected demand slowdown
  - Supply chain disruptions
  - Macroeconomic headwinds
  - Competitive pressure
  - However, NVIDIA has a strong track record of meeting/beating guidance

- If guidance itself were to be revised downward (extremely unlikely this late in the quarter):
  - Major geopolitical event affecting China export restrictions
  - Catastrophic demand shock
  - Unforeseen financial/operational crisis

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- If asking for actual reported revenue:
  - Stronger-than-expected AI/data center demand
  - Better-than-expected execution
  - NVIDIA typically beats guidance (historical pattern)
  - Analyst consensus is $91.9B (slightly above midpoint)

- If guidance were revised upward (also very unlikely):
  - Unexpected acceleration in AI deployment
  - Market share gains from competitors
  - Strategic wins with major customers

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 revenue: $81.6 billion (20% sequential growth)
- Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0 billion ± 2% (implying ~12% sequential growth)
- Q2 FY2026 (year-ago): $46.7 billion (96% YoY growth implied)
- Analyst consensus: ~$91.9 billion (within guidance range)

Historical context: NVIDIA has demonstrated consistent ability to meet/beat guidance. The sequential growth rate from Q1 to Q2 (~12%) is more conservative than Q4→Q1 (~20%), which is reasonable given typical seasonality and the large absolute base.

---

## Interpretation Note

The phrasing "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance" combined with the research showing guidance already issued creates an interpretation question. I interpret this as asking: **What is the forward guidance that NVIDIA issued for Q2 FY2027?**

The answer is unambiguous: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**.

However, if this question resolves to actual reported revenue for Q2 FY2027, the distribution would be slightly higher, centered around analyst consensus (~$91.9B), with upside bias due to NVIDIA's track record.

Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 92800000000

NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, is an expected $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

For comparison, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion in Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% sequentially [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). Analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), which falls within NVIDIA's guidance range (floor near $89.2 billion, ceiling near $92.8 billion) [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The year-ago quarter (Q2 FY2026) revenue was $46.7 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
